question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China's General Secretary of the Communist Party, Xi Jinping, is removed from power for any length of time between July 3, 2025, and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: Xi Jinping’s consolidated authority within the Chinese Communist Party and its institutions underpins the 95% trader consensus that he will not be removed from power before 2027. Recent military purges, including investigations of senior PLA figures such as Central Military Commission vice chairman He Weidong, have further centralized control without visible internal opposition or factional challenges. No designated successor has emerged, and analyses point to expectations of a fourth term at the 21st Party Congress in late 2027 rather than earlier transition. Diplomatic activity, including multiple high-level meetings in 2026, shows continuity in his leadership role. The absence of formal age-based retirement rules or credible reports of health or political setbacks sustains market pricing around extended rule into the 2030s.
